Act: Confirm SHUTDOWN handler calls and nulls unsubscribeTransition

tests.id: bootSceneTransitionStore.test.ts::fades out exactly once per transitionTo after create
tests.name: fades out exactly once per transitionTo after create
tests.title: BootScene transitionTo subscription handle: fades out exactly once per transitionTo after create
tests.scenario: Given BootScene has been created with a fake main camera, When transitionTo is emitted once for library, Then the camera fades out exactly once
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionStore.test.ts -t 'exactly once per transitionTo' --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: 1 passed, 1 skipped in the file run

tests.id: bootSceneTransitionStore.test.ts::fades out once on the new scene after shutdown and re-create
tests.name: fades out once on the new scene after shutdown and re-create
tests.title: BootScene transitionTo subscription handle: fades out once on the new scene after shutdown and re-create
tests.scenario: Given the first BootScene is shut down via its SHUTDOWN callback, When a second BootScene is created and transitionTo is emitted once, Then only the second scene fades out, once, and the first scene's fadeOut is never called
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionStore.test.ts -t 're-create' --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: 1 passed, 1 skipped in the file run

tests.name: file loads with the mocks
tests.title: BootScene transitionTo subscription handle: file loads with the mocks (Step 1)
tests.scenario: Given the phaser and content vi.mock blocks, When the whole file runs, Then both tests load and pass
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionStore.test.ts --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: transitionTo ignored after SHUTDOWN while other subscribers stay active

tests.name: fades the camera out on transitionTo before shutdown
tests.title: BootScene transitionTo shutdown > fades the camera out on transitionTo before shutdown
tests.scenario: Given BootScene is created and SHUTDOWN has not run, When transitionTo is emitted, Then fadeOut is called once with TRANSITION_FADE_MS
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionShutdown.test.ts -t 'fades the camera out on transitionTo before shutdown'

tests.name: ignores transitionTo after the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.title: BootScene transitionTo shutdown > ignores transitionTo after the SHUTDOWN callback runs
tests.scenario: Given the SHUTDOWN callback has run, When transitionTo is emitted for library, Then fadeOut and scene.start are not called
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionShutdown.test.ts -t 'ignores transitionTo'

tests.name: keeps other transitionTo subscribers active after shutdown
tests.title: BootScene transitionTo shutdown > keeps other transitionTo subscribers active after shutdown
tests.scenario: Given a spy subscribed to transitionTo before create() and SHUTDOWN has run, When transitionTo is emitted with {sceneId: 'library'}, Then the spy receives the payload and fadeOut is not called
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionShutdown.test.ts -t 'other transitionTo subscribers'
